svg.title: Rotor circuits
svg.text: DCCREG turbine: the rotor's two circuits as built (tube, wound utrons; rotor and counter-rotor geared 1 : −1)

(a) the reluctance pump drives the AH pair, all on the rotor · (b) the electrostatic pump drives the bicone, across both bodies · operating point g 0.5 / 6 bridges / 1200 rpm relative · only diodes switch
(a) RELUCTANCE: magnetic dual doubler → AH pair
(b) ELECTROSTATIC: de Queiroz diode doubler → bicone
6 SiFe bridges per side: passive iron, no wires
B row 30° offset · radial gap 0.5 mm at r 130 mm
ROTOR · the whole circuit, no rotating contact
into the utron loop at start-up
stator vanes, the Ca / Cb plates, the diodes and clamps
nodes 1–4 run negative, clamped at −20 kV
wound utrons at 0 / 120 / 240°, 200 t of Ø1.55 mm Cu: 81.0 / 9.4 mH (aligned / unaligned), 0.58 Ω each
L̂ 0.243 H, ratio κ 8.6, τ = L/R 0.140 s; Ψs 0.134 Wb-t (the 3.0 mm NiFe neck)
a passing bridge closes the utron's flux path: L(θ) 6 × per rev; B row half a pitch on
anti-Helmholtz pair at the hub, one coil per branch: 160 t, 1.01 mH, 0.27 Ω each [RH]
0.146 H (0.6 L̂), 0.29 Ω (τ 0.5 s) [RH]: gapped cores, not designed
4.4 mH wiring stray, as modelled (dual of Cpar) [IR]
Si, 0.55 V at 1 A; 2.8 A peak; reverse voltage not yet checked
At 1200 rpm relative (120 Hz): 0.87–2.81 A in each branch, 101 V peak per group; AH 139–449 A-turns.
Belt 17.6 W = utron Cu 6 × 2.15 + La / Lb 0.66 + AH 2.00 + diodes 2.01 W; + iron 1.25 W = 18.8 W.
8 + 8 vanes, 6 sectors, 3 mm vacuum gaps: 71.1–1113 pF (κ 15.7); C2 in antiphase
8 fixed plates each (4 at each node): 1225 pF (1.1 C_max)
HV diode stacks for the 20 kV swing (part not chosen)
avalanche clamps, BV 20 kV; option: a 20 kV spark gap + quench diode (the dump)
the bicone halves, 32 t, 89.5 µH, 0.05 Ω each; M 25.8 µH (k 0.288, aiding) [RH]
rail to shaft: carries the cone current (mA); with the dump, the 21 A pulses
At 600 rpm relative (60 Hz; the pick runs 1200 rpm, 120 Hz, about twice the power: not re-run):
diodes only: belt 9.1 W into the clamps; cones 1.7 mA rms (0.12 A-turns): the bicone is decorative.
dump: 21 A peak, 683 A-turns, 54 mJ per dump, 60 per s per side, ring 1.8 MHz.

Bodies. Rotor: shaft, sleeve, rotor vanes (R-A, R-B), the 6 utrons on their carrier discs, the hub (bicone, AH pair). Counter-rotor: stator cage, stator vanes, Ca / Cb plates, bridges. Frame: end bearings, the gear.

Not in the solids yet: La, Lb, D1*–D4*, the RC snubbers and the kick source (rotor); D1–D4 and Z1 / Z4 (counter-rotor). The two pumps share only the shaft; each one's reaction torque goes into the gear.
(a) is the planar dual of (b) [OC]: C → L, V → I, Q → Ψ, Ca / Cb → La / Lb, Cpar → Lp2 / Lp3, D1–D4 → D1*–D4*, the 20 kV clamp → the NiFe neck's saturation.

A and B swap every half cycle: one group generates (L falling) while the other motors. The AH coils are named by branch; sim/magnetic_doubler.py calls them AH top / bottom (A was then the upper side).

Numbers: sim/pole_design_variants_op.json (g 0.5 / 6 bridges / 1200 rpm), sim/utron_profile.py, sim/bicone_drive_results.json, sim/tube_geometry_wound_results.json · netlists: sim/magnetic_doubler.py, sim/bicone_drive.py
